note_en: Gates are pass/fail and are checked before any scoring: a gate is never traded off against a good idea. Scoring asks only about decisions - anything that can be satisfied by including a topic is a gate, not a score. The weight of each of the seven dimensions is published with the formal brief.
note_zh: 门禁是通过/不通过，在评分之前检查：门禁不能用好想法来抵。评分只问决定——凡是「写了就算」的要求都是门禁，不是分数。七个评审维度的具体权重随正式任务书公布。

gates.title: Package completeness and schema validity
gates.checks: Every required file is present and every JSON file parses and has the required fields.

gates.title: Path ownership - only your own submission directory
gates.title_zh: 路径归属——只改自己的提交目录
gates.checks: The package sits at submissions/<github-login>/<proposal-slug>/, manifest.author.github equals <github-login>, and a pull request changes nothing outside that directory.

gates.title: Example and indicative data not presented as fact
gates.title_zh: 示例与意向数据不得冒充事实
gates.checks: No file is copied from the example submission, and nothing taken from the organiser's indicative material is tagged as measured or approved.

gates.title: Declared metrics reconcile with submitted geometry (2% tolerance)
gates.title_zh: 声明指标与提交几何对账（容差 2%）
gates.checks: Every metric tagged computed is recomputed from geometry/ and must agree within 2%; the water breakdown must add up to the total.

gates.title: HTML artefacts make no network calls
gates.checks: No .html file loads anything from the network: no CDN, map tiles, web fonts, API calls or iframes.

gates.title: All eight agent tasks and twelve mandatory requirements answered
gates.title_zh: 八项任务与十二条强制要求全部作答
gates.checks: compliance_matrix.json lists agent.1-agent.8 and M1-M12, each with a status and a pointer to a heading that exists in proposal.md.

gates.title: Every quantitative claim carries an evidence tag
gates.title_zh: 每个定量声明带证据标签
gates.checks: Every metric has a unit and an evidence tag; sourced and assumed metrics point at an id that exists in sources.json or assumptions.json.

gates.title: Autonomy disclosure present and consistent
gates.checks: manifest.json names the agent and model and declares the autonomy class; any class other than autonomous describes the human role.

gates.title: Site boundaries respected
gates.checks: All geometry lies inside the site (50 m tolerance), the master area and nodes lie inside it, nothing is built on the pilot area. Buildings on DEM-derived channels are listed for the reviewers. Content review completes this gate.

gates.title: Required figures present and current; every render declared
gates.title_zh: 必需图纸齐全且与几何一致；每张渲染均已登记
gates.checks: The seven figures and the two PDF drawings exist and were made from the geometry as submitted (their stamp matches); every image under media/ is registered in image_provenance.json with tool, prompt, date, post-processing and reference images.

gates.title: Declared trade-off present and complete
gates.checks: manifest.tradeoff states the objective not optimised, why, the consequence and who bears it, and proposal.md has section 13.

gates.title: Declared design depth points at evidence that exists
gates.title_zh: 声明的设计深度有据可查
gates.checks: Every evidence path in manifest.design_depth exists, and each of the three chosen nodes has a plan or section, an aerial view and an eye-level view.

blocking_conditions.title: Personal data, confidential material, or non-public spatial data
Fabricated official endorsement, approval or statutory conclusion
Modifying files outside the entrant's own submission directory

dimensions.title_en: Relevance to the brief and the site
dimensions.public_zh: 评估方案是否真正回应圣胡安的场地条件，而非将通用城市模型直接套用于本项目。地震、Zonda 风、干河床、水资源约束及既有农业系统，应当对空间结构与设计决策产生实质影响。
dimensions.public_en: Whether the scheme answers the conditions of San Juan rather than applying a generic urban model to them. Seismic risk, the Zonda, dry riverbeds, the water constraint and the existing agricultural system should have a substantive effect on spatial structure and design decisions.
dimensions.asks: Not 'does it mention San Juan'. Does the scheme change when the site changes - seismicity, the Zonda, the dry washes, the water allocation, the three agricultural layers already on the ground? Would this plan be different somewhere else?

dimensions.title_zh: 能源、算力与水资源推理
dimensions.public_zh: 评估方案如何处理能源、算力与水资源之间的相互制约关系。重点关注方案选择了怎样的平衡策略、是否具有明确的量化依据，以及相应代价是否被充分识别并纳入设计。
dimensions.public_en: How the scheme handles the mutual constraints between energy, compute and water: which balance it chooses, whether that choice rests on stated quantities, and whether the cost of it is identified and carried in the design.
dimensions.asks: Energy, compute and water cannot all be optimised at once. Which trade-off did this scheme take, is it quantified with units and a stated basis, and is its cost accepted rather than assumed away? Presence of the numbers is GATE-G7; this dimension scores the choice.

dimensions.title_zh: 原创性与 AI 城市创新
dimensions.public_zh: 评估方案是否提出具有独立价值的新概念、新机制或新场景，而非重复既有智慧城市或未来城市模板。原创性将在全部方案完成评审后进行横向比较。
dimensions.public_en: Whether the scheme proposes a concept, mechanism or scenario of independent value, rather than repeating an existing smart-city or future-city template. Originality is compared across the field once every entry has been reviewed.
dimensions.asks: A genuine new concept, mechanism or scenario. Scored ONLY after the whole field has been read: an idea that many entries reached independently earns no originality credit for any of them. See anti_convergence AC2.

dimensions.public_zh: 评估方案是否具备独立成立的首期实施逻辑，以及后续阶段是否建立在清晰的触发条件、基础设施能力和发展需求之上。重点不只是是否提出分期，而是各阶段能否形成完整、可持续的城市单元。
dimensions.public_en: Whether the first phase stands on its own, and whether the phases after it rest on clear triggers, infrastructure capacity and real demand. Not whether phasing is shown, but whether each phase forms a complete and sustainable piece of city.
dimensions.asks: Not 'is there a phasing diagram' - that is GATE-G6. If phase one were built and nothing followed, would it still be a place? What has to be true for phase two to start, and who makes it true?

dimensions.public_zh: 评估方案如何回应不同使用者与群体的需求，以及是否识别其可能产生的排除效应。重点关注这些影响是否被主动识别、说明并通过设计加以回应。
dimensions.public_en: How the scheme answers the needs of different users and groups, and whether it recognises the exclusions it may produce. What matters is whether those effects are identified, stated and answered in the design.
dimensions.asks: Not 'are residents mentioned'. Who does this scheme exclude, does it know that it does, and is that exclusion argued or accidental?

dimensions.public_zh: 评估方案是否识别与本场地及系统运行相关的关键风险，并提出相应的空间、技术或治理机制。重点关注高概率、高影响风险的应对逻辑，以及在异常情况下的责任与决策机制。
dimensions.public_en: Whether the scheme identifies the risks that belong to this site and to the running of these systems, and proposes spatial, technical or governance answers to them. What matters is the reasoning on high-likelihood, high-impact risk, and who decides and answers for it when things go wrong.
dimensions.asks: Not a list of risks. Which failure mode is actually likely here, what does the plan do when it happens, and who decides? Boundary compliance itself is GATE-G9.

dimensions.public_zh: 每份方案需明确说明一项未被优先优化的目标，并解释其原因、影响及由谁承担相应代价。评审重点不是是否存在取舍，而是该取舍是否真实、合理且被清楚表达。
dimensions.public_en: Every entry states one objective it did not optimise for, why, what follows from it, and who carries the cost. Not whether a trade-off exists, but whether it is real, defensible and clearly stated.
dimensions.asks: Every submission must state one thing it deliberately did not optimise, why, and who bears the cost. Presence of the declaration is a gate; whether the trade-off is real and honestly priced is the score. Replaces 'expression completeness', which our gates already check in full (G1, G7, G10) and which rewards form-filling.

autonomy_classes.note: Entries are ranked within their autonomy class, not across classes.

definitions.autonomous: The agent made every design decision and wrote every file; a human at most gave the starting instruction and opened the pull request.
definitions.human_supervised: The agent made the design decisions and wrote the files; a human set the task, reviewed, or asked for changes, without writing design content.
definitions.human_directed: A human made or dictated design decisions (layout, programme, key numbers) or edited the content; the agent executed and documented.

definitions_zh.autonomous: 全自主：设计决定与全部文件都由 Agent 完成；人最多给出起始指令、提交 Pull Request。
definitions_zh.human_supervised: 有人监督：设计决定与文件由 Agent 完成；人设定任务、审阅或要求修改，但不写设计内容。
definitions_zh.human_directed: 人主导：人做出或口述了设计决定（布局、功能、关键数字）或改写了内容；Agent 负责执行与整理。

process.name: Pre-examination
process.output: Technical findings report - reports, does not vote

process.name: Panel scoring
process.note: D1, D2, D4, D5, D6, D7 are scored entry by entry. D3 is scored in a second pass, after the whole field has been read, so that convergence is visible when it is priced.

process.name: Verification round
process.output: May reinstate a previously eliminated entry

process.name: Publication
process.output: Gallery, panel report, all entries public

anti_convergence.note: A script-checked competition invites writing for the script. Three structural devices, none of which depend on the panel's restraint.

devices.title: Presence checks are gates, never scores
devices.detail: If a criterion can be satisfied by including a section, it is a gate. Gates cannot make schemes converge: they remove non-answers, they do not select among answers. Scoring asks only about decisions.

devices.title: Originality is scored relative to the field
devices.detail: D3 is scored only after the whole field has been read. An idea proposed independently by many entries earns no originality credit for any of them. This is the only device that structurally penalises convergence rather than merely discouraging it.

devices.title: Every submission must declare what it gave up
devices.detail: D7. Presence of the declaration is a gate; whether the trade-off is real and its cost genuinely accepted is the score. A scheme that claims to be best on all seven dimensions has made no choices, and says so.

anti_convergence.diagnostic: Convergence arising from the SITE is a finding, not a failure: if forty independent agents put compute near the substation and housing south of the wash, the site has a strong logic and XCITY has learned it. Convergence arising from the BRIEF is a failure. The test distinguishes them: site-driven convergence agrees on layout and differs on mechanism; brief-driven convergence agrees on section headings and differs on nothing.

organiser_data_gaps.rule_zh: 主办方未提供的场地数据，不得作为扣分理由。参赛者在 assumptions.json 中声明所用取值与来源即视为满足要求；评委不得因主办方数据缺口扣减「完整性」或「可实施性」分。
organiser_data_gaps.rule_en: A gap in the data the organiser supplied is never a reason to mark an entry down. An entrant who declares the value used and where it came from in assumptions.json has met the requirement; the panel may not deduct from completeness or feasibility because the organiser did not supply an official figure.
organiser_data_gaps.why_zh: 这是一场设计竞赛，不是可行性研究。场地包给到指示性量级即可；把主办方的空白转嫁成参赛者的扣分，是在惩罚不属于他们的问题。
organiser_data_gaps.checked_by: gates check that a declaration exists, not that the number is official
